issues.what: -a is a dark ropy pahoehoe crust with fine glowing seams; -b is a flat, even grey cracked-mud playa with regular polygon cracks, bright cartoon lava lines, and an evenly lit CG surface
issues.fix: replace the floor with a ropy, uneven basalt crust that has varied roughness, wet-black and matte-grey patches, and thin irregular glowing seams that fade under crust

issues.where: the caldera walls, the arch cave and the mesa at right
issues.what: -a's walls are dark, eroded basalt with talus and sulphur streaks, set low and far; -b's are tall, pale, finely layered sandstone cliffs with sharp peaks on the skyline, and the mesa is a smooth grey block lost in fog. The scale and the geology both read as a different place
issues.fix: lower and darken the rim, give it blocky basalt layering, talus fans and yellow fumarole staining, and model the mesa as a dark eroded butte with a lit face

issues.where: the centre, behind the main herd
issues.what: -b adds a large dark smoke column with a bright orange glowing base on the floor. -a has none; its plume rises from the right behind the mesa, and its strongest glow is at the far right horizon
issues.fix: remove the central plume and glow pool, and move the plume and the orange haze back to the right behind the mesa

issues.what: -b is a flat, cool, grey overcast with a blue sky and uniform haze. It lacks -a's dusk warmth, the lava underlighting the fume and rock, and the deep falloff to dark in the foreground
issues.fix: warm the haze, darken the foreground and sky, and let the lava cast orange bounce onto nearby rock, smoke and the animals' undersides

issues.what: the rocks are sharp, faceted low-poly shards with a stretched, smeared texture and specular sheen; -a has rounded, weathered scoria and ropy crust. The fumarole sulphur in -b is a pasted pale-yellow slab
issues.fix: use rounded, porous rock with soft contact shadows, and blend the sulphur crust into the rock as a stain and fringe

issues.where: the ribcage carcass and debris in the right middle ground
issues.what: the carcass sits on a flat decal disc of different texture, and there are extra prop piles (a rubble heap and a log) that -a lacks. The right-hand lava fire throws particle sparks, where -a has a low, smoky fire line
issues.fix: seat the carcass into the crust without a visible footprint, remove the extra props, and make the right-hand fire a low, fume-wrapped burning seam

issues.where: the lava channel and the floor around it (see set-A-04)
issues.what: -a has a ropy, coiled pahoehoe crust with folded, glowing toes; -b has smooth, rubbery, extruded slabs with banded displacement stepping, and a flat, plasticky, featureless floor that reads as clay
issues.fix: rebuild the flow with ropy coils, crust plates that break over glowing cores, and high-frequency rough basalt detail across the floor

issues.where: the left foreground rocks and cliff
issues.what: the pale, square, sandstone-like blocks and the bright orange, sponge-textured cliff at upper left do not match -a's dark scoria and sulphur-crusted boulders with steam
issues.fix: replace them with dark, rounded volcanic boulders with sulphur patches, and let steam rise from them; drop the orange cliff tint

issues.where: the background rim, arch and horizon
issues.what: the rim is tall layered cliffs with a ring-lit arch and a large central smoke column; the horizon is a hard, bright orange band at a different eye level. -a has a low, hazy basalt rim, a lava fall from the arch, and pinpoint glows along the far floor
issues.fix: lower and darken the rim, soften it with haze, restore the lava fall, and break the horizon glow into scattered seam lights

issues.what: -a's walkers are tall, thin-legged giraffe-like figures lit by the rim; -b's main animal is a squat, insect-like body with a long drooping neck, reading as a different creature in silhouette
issues.fix: match -a's tall upright stance and long legs, with a hanging tendril neck and the lit, fringed mouth

issues.where: the depth of field and grade
issues.what: -a's close macro has a shallow focus falloff and warm dusk contrast; -b is flatter and greyer, with lower contrast in the foreground
issues.fix: deepen the foreground shadows and warm the grade toward -a's dusk

issues.where: the foreground floor around the carcass (see set-A-06)
issues.what: -a has a rough, ropy crust filling the whole frame; -b has a flat, smooth, untextured grey plane with the carcass sitting on a raised disc of contour-banded displacement that ends on a visible edge
issues.fix: carry the ropy crust right across the floor and blend the carcass mound into it with no visible border

issues.where: the background walls, arch and plume
issues.what: as in 01: layered tan cliffs with peaks, a ring-glowing arch, and a central smoke column with a glowing base. -a has a low, dark basalt rim, a lava fall from the arch, and the glow at the right behind the mesa
issues.fix: restore the dark, low rim and the lava fall, and move the plume and glow back to the right

issues.what: -a's walker is gaunt, with a fibrous bark-like hide and lit tendrils; -b's has a heavy ribbed torso, thick legs, a glowing particle-fan mouth and a darker body that loses the rim light. A small white glowing speck floats near its legs
issues.fix: thin the body and legs, give it -a's weathered hide and soft lit tendrils, and remove the stray speck

issues.what: in -b, a single straight, uniform steam column rises from a bright lava pocket. In -a, a faint, wispy smoke curls over a small ember
issues.fix: reduce the steam to thin, drifting wisps and shrink the ember glow

issues.what: -b's sky is cool and blue, and its light is flat; it lacks -a's warm, smoky dusk and the lava bounce on the carcass and floor
issues.fix: warm and darken the grade, and add an orange underlight from the seams

issues.what: the bark plates are a regular, tiled scale pattern, against -a's irregular peeling bark
issues.fix: break up the tiling with irregular peeling plates and fibres
